newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Arafat charms French leader calling him Dr Chirac.
newsitem.headline: Arafat charms French leader calling him Dr Chirac.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat on Wednesday charmed French President Jacques Chirac repeatedly addressing him as Dr Chirac.
Chirac, who is neither a medical doctor nor a PhD holder appeared pleased as Arafat called him "your excellency Dr Chirac", during a landmark visit to the Palestinian-ruled town of Ramallah.

Arafat said he began using the title last March when, after a spate of suicide bombings in Israel threatened his peace deal with Israel, the French leader told him to "call Dr Chirac whenever you feel you are in need of help."
